$comment: The envelope a `git commit -am` session would have been sealed with, governing test/testdata/replay/git-operation.jsonl. Written the way an honest one would be: filesystem access across the workspace, the one binary the task runs, and a denial carving CI configuration back out of the broad write grant. Nothing here was arranged to make a finding appear.

intent.summary: Run git commit in the project.

grants.rationale: git reads the index, the object store, and the files being committed.
A commit writes the index and new objects.
New loose objects and lock files are created under .git/.
git writes through a lock file and renames it into place.
The task is a git invocation.
Exit is observed for the same binary.

denials.rationale: CI configuration is supply-chain surface. The workspace-wide write grant would otherwise swallow it, and a denial is the only thing that wins over a grant.
